name: cc-marketplace
description: Etienne's Claude Code plugin marketplace — custom productivity and development plugins

plugins.name: session-insights
plugins.description: Persistent session insights — Claude writes interaction observations at session end, you curate when the file grows. Provides /reflect (manual), /curate (prune), and file-size nudge via SessionStart hook.

plugins.name: websearch
plugins.description: Web search for deployments where the built-in WebSearch tool is unavailable (Bedrock, Vertex). A skill composes and triggers searches, a permission rule gates each outbound query, and an async hook keeps an audit log.

plugins.name: fortls-lsp
plugins.description: Fortran language server (fortls) integration for Claude Code
